payload.claim: Two line citations in the Context section are wrong (missed by the earlier citation-repair commit fc5dcc9e). 'It calls commit_finish with no emit, so the default print reaches the log (:1106-1113)' cites the write_findings try/except, not the commit_finish call, which actually sits at cli.py lines 1119-1126. 'The follow-ups adapter exports .saffron/ at the pinned base into follow-ups/<batch key> (saffron/cli.py:1638-1640)' cites the run() docstring/signature, not the export_saffron_dir call, which actually sits at cli.py lines 1651-1653. The substantive claims are true, only the pointers are off.
